records.name: Airlift
records.rationale: Wind rises in the selected group footprint while caster artwork lifts slightly. Group destination and creature/object transport remain manual; no damage is invented.

records.name: Ancestral Form
records.rationale: A translucent quasi-corporeal silhouette and spirit veil develop around caster. Granted fly capability does not force movement; no damaging arcane impact.

records.name: Antimagic Field
records.rationale: Full native description retains its existing direct-delivery art. Counts or conditional outcomes follow selected targets/manual options; no additional change justified.

records.name: Beseech Arcanotheign
records.rationale: Remote incarnate location and Arrive/Depart staging need native point/choice integration; current cue remains symbolic at caster. Half-black/white herald art unavailable.

records.name: Blast of the Bellows
records.rationale: A warm rotating air eddy occupies the selected burst. Descending flight outcomes depend on later entry/turn checks and are not forced at creation.

records.name: Blazing Bolt
records.rationale: Full native description retains its existing direct-delivery art. Counts or conditional outcomes follow selected targets/manual options; no additional change justified.

records.name: Blazing Dive
records.rationale: Superheated lift precedes a cosmetic ascent/descent and then fire spreads through the native emanation. Actual empty destination and elevation remain manual; no creature target required.

records.name: Blightburn Blast
records.rationale: Full native description retains its existing direct-delivery art. Counts or conditional outcomes follow selected targets/manual options; no additional change justified.

records.name: Burglar's Blind
records.rationale: A quiet fading silhouette and subdued sound envelope indicate the two stealth illusions. Gold in introductory motivation does not recolor spell as treasure; hostile-action ending remains native.

records.name: Call Fluxwraith
records.rationale: Remote mirror-shard incarnate location and separate Arrive/Depart effects require manual configuration; current generic summon cue remains symbolic.

records.name: Call of the Quenching
records.rationale: Mile-scale implicit area is absent from native area metadata; distant sea creatures and later Fuel summon require manual scene handling. Current source cue remains symbolic.

records.name: Chrysopoetic Curse
records.rationale: Gold-colored surface traces illustrate the transforming curse. The gold-terrain critical branch and conditional equipment penalties are not assumed.

records.name: Clad In Metal
records.rationale: A silver surface sweep symbolizes precious-metal replacement, not damage or weapon attacks. Metal choice and object surface require configuration or a holder/stand-in token.

records.name: Clockwork Devotion
records.rationale: Remote clockwork army and timed departure explosion remain manual; current generic caster cue is incomplete. No literal clockwork army art bundled.

records.name: Cloud Current
records.rationale: Mist and a directional current cue illustrate the high airborne cloud. The 10-mile cloud, altitude, direction and remote starting point require manual scene handling; no water impact.

records.name: Dancing Blade
records.rationale: The animated weapon flies to the selected creature, Strikes on arrival and remains near it briefly. Later Change Partners/Sustain Strikes are excluded; longsword art is a weapon stand-in.

records.name: Deep Sight
records.rationale: Two pitch-black eye accents form on a cosmetic silhouette, then a quiet vision veil settles. Eye positions are symbolic; no unrelated purple impact or actual vision change.

records.name: Deluge
records.rationale: A sudden water surge descends into the placed burst and promptly dissipates. Forced descent/push and structure collapse depend on native results, not animation-driven token updates.

records.name: Draconic Barrage
records.rationale: Three orbiting spark shapes symbolize the described small group of tiny dragons; three is visual decoration, not a rule count. Later dragon bombardment requires Sustain and is not fired during cast. Chosen damage remains manual.

records.name: Echoing Weapon
records.rationale: A quiet humming envelope charges the weapon. Strikes and the end-of-turn sonic discharge happen later, not during casting. Use a stand-in token or holder for the weapon.

records.name: Elemental Gift
records.rationale: A non-damaging elemental blessing settles on the willing recipient. Player chooses the element; no future fire/electricity Strike, automatic flight or recoil occurs during this neutral default.

records.name: Elemental Motion
records.rationale: Elemental movement capability develops on caster; choosing element and using the granted Speed remain manual. Casting itself does not move or attack.

records.name: Etheric Shards
records.rationale: Glittering force splinters spread as a caltrop field. Later damage requires moving through it; no divine-smite hit at creation. Blade art is a symbolic splinter substitute.

records.name: Falling Sky
records.rationale: Telekinetic field visibly presses downward and settles into floor pressure. Native cylinder is retained; elevation-dependent fall damage and conditions remain mechanical.

records.name: Fallow Field
records.rationale: Sickly yellow light fills the native field, suppressing future healing. No dark-purple tentacles, void attack or automatically denied healing at cast.

records.name: Fire Seeds
records.rationale: Four red-orange hand-held acorn glints grow, using symbolic point art. Later Interact throws, explosions and burning ground are not played at creation.

records.name: Flurry of Claws
records.rationale: Full native description retains its existing direct-delivery art. Counts or conditional outcomes follow selected targets/manual options; no additional change justified.

records.name: Force Fling
records.rationale: One spectral weapon echo flies to the selected foe and makes one contact. It does not automatically return like Spiritual Armament; held weapon identity remains symbolic.

records.name: Funeral Flames
records.rationale: Blue flame ignites one end of the held club/staff. Weapon attacks and optional dismissal damage happen later; no target shake or orange fireball during this buff.

records.name: Garden of the Green Man's Growth
records.rationale: Remote green-man arrival, 60-foot ground bloom and later selected vines need manual native point/phase integration; current cue remains generic.

records.name: Heat Metal
records.rationale: A localized red-hot sheen develops on the selected metal surface, with a restrained heat shimmer. No external fireball or assumed save-dependent persistent residue; object/holder targeting needs a stand-in.

records.name: Holy Host
records.rationale: Holy squadron choice, remote army location and separate Arrive/Depart phases require customization; current generic caster cue does not faithfully illustrate every choice.

records.name: Impaling Briars
records.rationale: Dangerous briars grow across the native emanation. Cast/Sustain option, temporary wall and separate directed impale attack remain manual; no default hit against caster.

records.name: Incarnate Shadow Minuet
records.rationale: Native shadow departure location and delayed darkness return require manual phase/location control; current source cue lacks that choreography.

records.name: Iron Rain
records.rationale: Silvery blade footage descends into the placed burst, then blades briefly remain as ground litter. No blue spell orb replaces the iron rain; picking up daggers and actual terrain remain native.

records.name: Jassim's Allegiance
records.rationale: Remote automaton arrival fire/piercing line and later rust emanation require manual point/phase integration; current generic caster cue remains incomplete.

records.name: Loose Time's Arrow
records.rationale: Full native description retains its existing direct-delivery art. Counts or conditional outcomes follow selected targets/manual options; no additional change justified.

records.name: Magnetic Attraction
records.rationale: One symbolic dagger object per selected stand-in flies toward caster, opposing normal outward attack direction. Alternate lodestone and real object Disarm/catch/drop require manual selection.

records.name: Magnetize
records.rationale: Stationary magnetic polarity surrounds the willing recipient. Redirecting future attacks is not played during casting.

records.name: Mantis's Grasp
records.rationale: Paired red spectral claw shapes sprout locally and close around the creature, followed by red force strands. Literal mantis arms are unavailable; immobilized save result is not applied.

records.name: Mirror's Misfortune
records.rationale: One distinct duplicate separates beside caster. Optional Step remains manual; later shattered-mirror curse does not trigger during cast.

records.name: Mislead
records.rationale: One duplicate remains while a separate caster silhouette fades. No three Mirror Image duplicates or automatic later attack; actual invisibility stays native.

records.name: Misty Memory
records.rationale: White mist rises from the selected water stand-in into a silent translucent tableau. No water impact or forced target movement; actual recalled scene/history is not invented.

records.name: Moonburst
records.rationale: A chilling silvery globe expands across the native burst and releases white-blue flecks. No yellow sacred flame or purple detection seal; permanent blindness remains save dependent.

records.name: Pernicious Poltergeist
records.rationale: A ghostly echo anchors in the placed burst. Deathly Assault/Frighten/Telekinetic Storm selection remains manual; no automatic generic contact. Literal ghost body is symbolic.

records.name: Personal Runewell
records.rationale: A circle of light carves the personal rune into the selected ground. Later spells trigger empowerment or force bolts; no impact/bolt at rune creation.

records.name: Pierce the Sky
records.rationale: Full native description retains its existing direct-delivery art. Counts or conditional outcomes follow selected targets/manual options; no additional change justified.

records.name: Precious Metals
records.rationale: A silver material sweep illustrates a deity blessing a metal object. Other metal choices remain manual; no attack or structural damage happens at cast.

records.name: Primal Summons
records.rationale: Prepare an elemental enhancement for the next summoned creature. This cast does not yet summon, fly, attack or choose the element.

records.name: Prismatic Spray
records.rationale: Seven individually colored ray lanes fan through the native cone: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet. Random creature-specific outcomes remain rules; Free ray recoloring preserves the lane geometry without holy breath.

records.name: Pummeling Rubble
records.rationale: Five illustrative heavy rock objects fan through the native cone before a faint footprint fades. No lightning cone, automatic save-result push or fabricated projectile count.

records.name: Pyrefowl Rebuke
records.rationale: Fiery arm-wing shimmer and one searing cue on the triggering foe accompany a cosmetic retreat directly away. Actual Fly destination and critical-failure dazzled/reaction suppression remain native.

records.name: Radiant Globe
records.rationale: A brilliant protective light dome forms around the footprint. Later crossing-projectile destruction is conditional, not a sacred-flame target hit at creation.

records.name: Rainbow's End
records.rationale: A rainbow light destination develops across the selected burst. Native spirit contact is illustrated by settling prismatic flecks; later ally teleport remains manual.

records.name: Recurring Nightmare
records.rationale: A spectral skull/veil symbolizes creation of a ghostly thrall, replacing misleading sleep art. The remote native thrall location, share-space fear save, later Strike and resummon remain native/manual; this is a local symbolic preparation cue.

records.name: Repel Metal
records.rationale: A field protects the threatened ally. Attack reflection requires the triggering Strike to miss; no reflected attack or target recoil is assumed.

records.name: Reverse Gravity
records.rationale: A field forms while particles move upward, illustrating reversed pull. Native cylinder footprint is preserved; actual falls, ceilings and later falling back remain rules.

records.name: River Carving Mountains
records.rationale: Roaring water and mist surround one cosmetic casting-time move. Manual actual path determines later difficult terrain; no persistent trail is fabricated.

records.name: Rust Cloud
records.rationale: Red-brown flecks agitate in an obscuring cloud. Symbolic particle footage replaces blue daggers; turn-start damage and metal-driven growth remain later mechanical events.

records.name: Sacred Nimbus
records.rationale: A fluffy white cloud forms over the selected square, followed by a faint descending water glimmer. Spirit damage waits until end of turn; no sacred flame impact at creation. Vertical rain is symbolic.

records.name: Shadow Spy
records.rationale: Dark bird-like shadow art forms with a small watching-eye accent. JB2A bats stand in for a crow/sparrow; remote homunculus location, outbound scouting route, delayed return and memory revelation remain manual. No magical attack.

records.name: Shock and Awe
records.rationale: Translucent explosions and flying-blade shapes suggest illusory battlefield ballistics throughout the area. No arms-of-Hadar tentacles or actual creature injury/conditions are assumed.

records.name: Shooting Star
records.rationale: A single ranged Strike travels to the chosen foe with a blazing meteor-like trail before contact. Native weapon identity and the hit-dependent lingering trail require customization; no self-only rune cue.

records.name: Sky Laughs at Waves
records.rationale: A cosmetic airborne approach reaches the chosen foe before one sword contact, then restores token pose. Actual flight route, destination and falling remain player/rules controlled.

records.name: Sky Sight
records.rationale: An upward vision accent and white stars develop quietly above caster. No attack, physical flight or automatic sight/lighting changes.

records.name: Slashing Gust
records.rationale: Air ripples reach each selected foe once, then a local wind slice follows. One/two free hands control actual target count; bleed occurs only on critical success and is not automatic residue.

records.name: Soul Cutter
records.rationale: Default adjacent spiritual sword cut uses local melee footage. Three-action ranged blade form needs configuration; no distant bolt or enfeebled save/result is assumed in the base cast.

records.name: Steal the Sky
records.rationale: Air support narrows and streams downward at the struck flying creature. The preceding successful unarmed Strike is not repeated; actual descent, landing damage and Fly denial remain save-dependent native events.

records.name: Storm Lord
records.rationale: Ominous clouds and wind form in the native emanation. Calm/fog/rain/wind choice and the separate single-action lightning bolt remain manual; no automatic targeted strike.

records.name: Storm of Vengeance
records.rationale: Large storm cloud and gales form over the native burst. The chosen cast/Sustain storm effect is not inferred; no automatic ten bolts, acid damage or thunderclap.

records.name: Under Sunless Skies
records.rationale: Mile-scale implicit area is absent from native area metadata; actual sun/light/vision and later Fuel command are mechanical/manual. Current local cue remains symbolic.

records.name: Unfolding Wind Blitz
records.rationale: A swift cosmetic airborne passage and trailing silhouette illustrate the casting-time Fly. Optional up-to-three unarmed Strikes and the chosen route require customization; no three automatic contacts.

records.name: Unholy Army
records.rationale: Unholy squadron choice, remote army location and separate Arrive/Depart phases require customization; current generic caster cue does not illustrate every choice.

records.name: Unseasonable Squall
records.rationale: One outward gust ripples across the placed burst and fades. Save-dependent prone/push and object motion are not imposed.

records.name: Untwisting Iron Augmentation
records.rationale: Two silvery hand glints represent cold-iron/silver unarmed capability. No cracks, environmental quake or automatic Strike.

records.name: Wall of Metal
records.rationale: A silver material veil prepares a barrier section. No dagger melee attack; actual 60-foot straight wall, material and placement require manual configuration because native area metadata is absent.

records.name: Wall of Water
records.rationale: Full straight 60-foot wall is not natively placed from metadata. Current local water material cue needs manual wall layout, dimension and position.

records.name: Wall of Wind
records.rationale: Flexible 60-foot barrier path is not natively placed from metadata. Current local wind cue needs manual wall layout and position.

records.name: Weapon Tide
records.rationale: Weapon silhouettes surge along the ground through the native cone. A longsword is the default slashing stand-in; bludgeoning/piercing and longer two-round forms need configuration. No later hazardous shooting is automatic.

records.name: Wrathful Storm
records.rationale: Clouds and wind form over the native burst. Blizzard/hail/lightning/tornado choices remain manual; no automatic icy spike explosion or thrown targets.

records.name: Zephyr Slip
records.rationale: A short wind veil precedes one cosmetic retreat away from the chosen triggering creature. Actual 15-foot route and heightened allies remain manual; token restores pose.

records.name: Zero Gravity
records.rationale: Soft particles float suspended inside the native cylinder footprint. No ground cracks, invented explosion or automatic Push Off.

records.name: Boots on the Ground
records.rationale: One illusory copy separates from each selected troop token; choose up to three troop stand-ins for the base cast. No music or intelligible speech is created. Gargantuan illustration needs actual troop-sized targets; heightened five duplicates require customization.

records.name: Canticle of Everlasting Grief
records.rationale: Small private melody imagery wraps the selected recipient, then a grief thread settles around them. No caster-wide performance, public sound, automatic fear or curse transmission.

records.name: Enthrall
records.rationale: A quiet attention thread develops around selected listeners. Native speech or song is player-chosen, so the neutral default does not prescribe musical notation or damage.

records.name: Fortissimo Composition
records.rationale: A restrained bardic inspiration spark prepares the caster next composition. It does not perform the upcoming composition, choose its targets or apply Performance results now.

records.name: Rune of Observation
records.rationale: Readable native reference now retains its eye/sensor meaning.
